title: Launch Pulse: cross-team announcement orchestration and publish timeline
creator: Ivy Ramirez
description: Create and execute a prescriptive orchestration plan for the upcoming product release that coordinates blog, email, social, and webinar channels across product, design, engineering, marketing, and support. Deliver a timeline, channel playbooks, approval matrix, and contingency/fallback policies so cross-functional teams can execute synchronized publishing with minimal friction.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Finalized timeline shared with stakeholders and added to shared calendar. 2) Blog draft + hero assets approved by Design and Legal. 3) Email sequences scheduled in marketing automation with localized variations. 4) Social kit (thread, images, short video) uploaded to shared folder. 5) Webinar date confirmed, registration page live, and moderator + recording plan set. 6) Release notes updated in the product changelog and SDK docs with PR links. 7) Post-launch triage process documented and on-call rota assigned.
milestones: 2026-03-09: Blog draft v1 + hero image (DES review)
2026-03-13: Legal/Trust review complete for public claims
2026-03-20: Email sequences QA + audience segmentation check
2026-03-24: Webinar rehearsal and slide deck lock
2026-03-26: Final approvals and publish windows locked
2026-03-30: Soft launch to beta customers (regional windows)
communication_plan: We will use a two-wave publish strategy: 1) Soft launch to beta customers and partners to validate telemetry and gather quick qualitative feedback; 2) Public launch in coordinated time windows to respect APAC/EMEA/NA time zones. Communication channels: Confluence for docs, Slack #launch-ops for real-time coordination, shared calendar invites for publish windows, marketing automation (Iterable) for email, Hootsuite for social scheduling, Zoom Webinar for event. Each channel has an owner and an approval checklist. The on-call engineer and support lead will be notified 30 minutes before each publish window.
stakeholders: Engineering: Lucas Chen (owner for runtime and release notes sync)
channel_playbooks: Blog: owner Priya Mehta. Steps = draft -> DES review -> Legal -> SEO pass -> schedule via CMS. Include demo GIF, TL;DR bullet list, and changelog link.

Email: owner Priya Mehta. Two sequences: Beta (small cohort) and Public. Include dynamic inserts for customer org and link to webinar registration. QA steps: link checks, unsubscribe and spam test, localization.

Social: owner Aaron Park. Produce primary thread, 3 short clips (30s), 4 images sized for X/LinkedIn. Use time-zone-aware windows; stagger posts for APAC first then EMEA/NA. Prepare pinned reply with changelog and roadmap CTA.

Webinar: owner Aaron Park + Helena Sørensen. Format: 30-minute product demo + 20-minute live Q&A. Roles: moderator, primary presenter, secondary demo engineer, support for chat. Rehearsal scheduled 2026-03-24. Recording to be edited and uploaded to Drive within 48 hours.

Release Notes / Changelog: owner Lucas Chen. Source of truth is GitHub CHANGELOG.md + SDK release notes. Must include partner-facing summary and upgrade notes. Link PRs and include migration steps where applicable. Ensure semantic versioning enforced and compatibility matrix updated.
Customer Support Triage: owner Helena Sørensen. Template answer strings, escalation flow, and hotfix policy prepared before public launch. First 72h escalation contact list published.
Assets: owner Maya Osei. Deliver hero image, thumbnail, short demo clips, and tweet-sized copy. Provide Figma file link and export folder in Drive.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Last-minute API incompatibility discovered. Mitigation: Run fast-canary (internal + beta) and hold public launch if >1% error rate after 2 hours. Rollback plan: revert to previous model variant and communicate to customers via email template A.

Risk: Legal flags marketing claims. Mitigation: Pre-schedule a legal review milestone and maintain a list of approved claim language. If flagged during final review, postpone by up to 48 hours and push updated copy across channels.
Risk: Webinar platform capacity exceeded. Mitigation: Use overflow YouTube stream and record for immediate playback; notify registrants via automated email with link.
Risk: Social scheduling misfire in a time zone. Mitigation: Centralized publish windows spreadsheet with UTC time and owner sign-off; manual override instructions included.
metrics_and_success_criteria: Primary KPIs: blog pageviews (target 20k first week), webinar registrations (target 2,500) and attendance rate (30%), email open rate >25% and CTR >5% for CTAs, new trial signups attributed to launch > 600 in first week, support ticket volume stable (no more than 1.5x baseline) and <5% of tickets are P0. Secondary: social impressions and demo video views, developer SDK downloads.
post_launch_actions: Within 24 hours: publish webinar recording, send thank-you email to attendees with CTA and recording link, pull initial telemetry dashboard and share triage report. Within 72 hours: iterate on FAQ and release notes based on incoming questions, schedule post-mortem with all stakeholders for Week +1. Create a short wins doc for leadership.
